item.skycraft.relic.aetherial_bow.desc: Auriel's own bow, waiting for its sunlit arrows.
item.skycraft.relic.amaund_writ.desc: A writ of execution. The name on it is the Emperor's.
item.skycraft.relic.amulet_of_saarthal.d: An old Nord amulet that hums whenever it's near powerful magic.
item.skycraft.relic.ancestor_moth.desc: Glowing moths drawn from the Ancestor Glade, which let a Moth Priest read a Scroll safely.
item.skycraft.relic.attunement_sphere.de: A humming Dwemer device that Septimus says will open the way to the Tower of Mzark.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_epistolar: A Black Book recovered from a Dwemer ruin. It wants to be read.
item.skycraft.relic.black_book_waking.de: Bound in something that is not leather. The pages move when you aren't looking.
item.skycraft.relic.black_soul_star.desc: Malyn Varen's soul is trapped inside, souring the Star.
item.skycraft.relic.crystal_shard.desc: A shard of the Crystal Tower's living stone, stolen by Maormer raiders.
item.skycraft.relic.delphine_note.desc: 'If you want the horn, rent the attic room at the Sleeping Giant Inn. Your friend.'
item.skycraft.relic.dragonstone.desc: A slab of carved stone mapping the burial mounds of dragons across Skyrim.
item.skycraft.relic.ebony_blade_relic.de: It grows sharper every time it betrays a friend.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_blood.d: Serana's scroll. It speaks of a bow, a prophecy, and the sun's death.
To look upon it is to see time itself, bent and folded. Handle with reverence.
item.skycraft.relic.elder_scroll_sun.des: Valerica's scroll, guarded in the Soul Cairn for an age.
item.skycraft.relic.eyes_of_the_falmer.d: Two great gems pried from a Dwemer statue. Worth more than most towns.
item.skycraft.relic.fellglow_books.desc: Three volumes on the Eye of Magnus, taken from Urag's shelves by a former student.
item.skycraft.relic.finns_lute.desc: A lute carved by the bard Finn. The strings still hold their tune.
item.skycraft.relic.focusing_crystal.des: A lens of Dwemer glass that once focused starlight in Mzulft's Oculory.
item.skycraft.relic.gallus_journal.desc: Written in old Falmer script. Someone in Winterhold might read it.
item.skycraft.relic.glenmoril_heads.desc: Grim trophies. Kodlak believes burning them will free a soul from Hircine's hunt.
item.skycraft.relic.goldenglow_bill.desc: Proof that someone has quietly bought Goldenglow Estate out from under its owner.
item.skycraft.relic.graht_seed.desc: The seed of a walking tree, pulled from the Wilderking's thorns.
item.skycraft.relic.heart_shard.desc: A splinter of red crystal from the depths of Red Mountain, still humming with old power.
item.skycraft.relic.hist_sap.desc: Amber sap from the Root Hist, free of the blight.
item.skycraft.relic.honningbrew_poison.d: Labeled pest poison. It is not pest poison.
item.skycraft.relic.horn_of_jurgen.desc: The plain war horn of the founder of the Greybeards' order.
item.skycraft.relic.jagged_crown.desc: The ancient crown of Skyrim's High Kings, made of dragon teeth and bone.
item.skycraft.relic.king_olaf_verse.desc: The lost Edda of King Olaf One-Eye, in his own scratchy hand.
item.skycraft.relic.legion_orders.desc: A demand that Whiterun admit a Legion garrison.
item.skycraft.relic.meridia_beacon.desc: A glowing orb that pulls you, gently, toward the Statue to Meridia.
item.skycraft.relic.miraak_note.desc: 'The usurper is in Skyrim. Go to Solstheim, find the stones, serve Miraak.' Unsigned.
item.skycraft.relic.moon_relic.desc: A silver lattice that catches both moons' light.
item.skycraft.relic.nahkriin_staff.desc: Nahkriin's staff, the key that opens the portal to Sovngarde.
item.skycraft.relic.oghma_infinium.desc: Hermaeus Mora's book of all knowledge. Reading it changes the reader.
item.skycraft.relic.orc_offering.desc: A tusk taken from the ogre that terrorized Wrothgar.
item.skycraft.relic.panteas_flute.desc: A silver flute that belonged to the College's finest musician.
item.skycraft.relic.peryite_incense.desc: Vampire dust, silver, deathbell and ruby, burned together. It smells exactly like you'd expect.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_altmer.desc: A crystal shard from a Summerset ruin.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_argonian.des: Sap from a sacred Hist tree.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_breton.desc: A spellbook taken from a coven's altar.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_dunmer.desc: Ash of a Dunmer ancestor, stolen from its family tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_foreign.desc: Nobody knows who made it, or what it's for.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_imperial.des: A glowing blue Ayleid stone, full of starlight.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_khajiit.desc: Sweet, sticky and sacred. Do not lick.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_orc.desc: A crude idol, stolen from a stronghold shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.radiant_redguard.des: A curved sword from an age before Hammerfell had its name.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_blade.desc: Broken shards of an impossibly sharp blade.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_hilt.desc: One piece of the dagger of the Prince of Destruction.
item.skycraft.relic.razor_pommel.desc: A pommel stone that glows like a coal.
item.skycraft.relic.rjorns_drum.desc: A war drum. Rjorn played it while the hagravens screamed.
item.skycraft.relic.rueful_axe.desc: Clavicus Vile wants Barbas dead with it. Barbas would rather not.
A sticky note, mostly wine stains: 'Misty Grove. Bring the staff. Bring yourself.'
item.skycraft.relic.shehai_blade.desc: The spirit-sword of a Yokudan Ra Gada warrior, sealed in its tomb.
item.skycraft.relic.sigil_stone.desc: Torn from the top of an Oblivion gate's tower. It's warm, and it pulses like a heart.
item.skycraft.relic.silver_hand_orders.d: Orders to burn Jorrvaskr's hounds out of their den, signed by Krev the Skinner.
item.skycraft.relic.skeleton_key.desc: Nocturnal's own key. It opens anything: locks, doors, minds.
Vaermina's staff. It feeds on dreams.
item.skycraft.relic.staff_relic_magnus.d: Old Morokei's prize. It drinks magicka from whatever it is pointed at.
item.skycraft.relic.stormcloak_axe.desc: A war axe, sent as a message: choose a side.
item.skycraft.relic.thalmor_dossier.desc: Thalmor notes on an old Blades archivist believed to hide beneath Riften.
item.skycraft.relic.troll_fat_offering.d: A slab of fat cut from a living troll, for Malacath's shrine.
item.skycraft.relic.vilkas_blade.desc: Notched from the training yard. Eorlund will know what to do with it.
item.skycraft.relic.wuuthrad_fragment.de: A shard of Ysgramor's legendary axe, carried home across the sea.
story.skycraft.npc.aela.greet: If you've come to stare, the training yard is around back. If you've come to hunt, talk to me.
story.skycraft.npc.alvor.greet: Iron, steel, a bit of leather. If you need it mended, my forge is warm.
story.skycraft.npc.amaund.greet: You are late. Never mind. What I am about to ask has not been asked in four hundred years.
story.skycraft.npc.ancano.greet: The Thalmor take an interest in the College's work. Purely as advisors, of course.
story.skycraft.npc.aranea.greet: The Lady of Twilight told me you would come. She tells me many things, at dusk and at dawn.
story.skycraft.npc.arngeir.greet: The Voice is a gift of the gods. We spend our lives learning to use it rightly. Few have the patience.
story.skycraft.npc.astrid.greet: Every family has its rules. Ours are simple: obey, don't betray, and never kill a Brother or Sister.
story.skycraft.npc.atub.greet: Largashbur is cursed. Our chief is too proud to ask the Furious One why. I am not.
story.skycraft.npc.aventus.greet: Go away. Unless... unless you're the one. Are you the one the Night Mother sent?
story.skycraft.npc.azadhi.greet: Jone and Jode are the two moons, walker. Masser and Secunda, you call them. Their dance tells Khajiit who we are.
story.skycraft.npc.balgruuf.greet: Whiterun stands at the heart of Skyrim, and I intend to keep it standing. What brings you before me?
story.skycraft.npc.bersi.greet: Pottery, fine pottery. And if you break it, you've bought it.
story.skycraft.npc.boethiah_cultist.gree: Boethiah respects only strength, and betrayal is a kind of strength. Have you come to prove yours?
story.skycraft.npc.brynjolf.greet: Never done an honest day's work in your life for all that coin you're carrying, eh lass? Or lad. The light's poor.
story.skycraft.npc.celinar.greet: You found Artaeum. Or Artaeum let itself be found by you. That distinction will matter, later.
story.skycraft.npc.cicero.greet: Hello, hello! Cicero tends the Mother. Cicero does not like to be interrupted. Unless it's for a joke!
story.skycraft.npc.deeja.greet: The Hist speaks in sap and dreams. This one listens. Lately, the Hist sounds afraid.
story.skycraft.npc.delphine.greet: Rooms are ten septims. Mead is cheaper. Questions cost more.
story.skycraft.npc.delvin.greet: Business has been terrible since the curse. Not that I believe in curses. Mostly.
story.skycraft.npc.dervenin.greet: My master is on vacation! He's in the head of a dead king, and he won't come out! Help a poor madman?
story.skycraft.npc.dexion.greet: A Moth Priest reads the Elder Scrolls, and pays for it with his eyes. I will pay, if the cause is worth it.
story.skycraft.npc.eola.greet: You look hungry. Not for bread, I think. For something rarer.
story.skycraft.npc.eorlund.greet: The Skyforge was old when the first Companions came. I only keep it fed.
story.skycraft.npc.erandur.greet: Dawnstar dreams badly, and every dream has the same mother. I know her name. I served her once.
story.skycraft.npc.esbern.greet: Forty years I've been waiting for the world to end. You'll forgive me if I'm not good company.
story.skycraft.npc.falion.greet: Morthal has little use for a conjurer, and less for questions. Still, you have the look of someone who needs one.
story.skycraft.npc.faralda.greet: The bridge is narrow and the drop is long. State your business with the College.
story.skycraft.npc.farengar.greet: Unless you've brought me a dragon, or something about dragons, I'm rather busy.
story.skycraft.npc.farkas.greet: Vilkas says I talk too much. I don't think so. Do you think so?
story.skycraft.npc.frea.greet: The All-Maker's stones are sick, and my people walk in their sleep. If you can help, help. If not, stand aside.
story.skycraft.npc.galmar.greet: You want to fight for Skyrim? Good. Let's see if you can.
story.skycraft.npc.geldis.greet: The Retching Netch serves the best sujamma on Solstheim. It's also the only sujamma on Solstheim.
story.skycraft.npc.gerdur.greet: The mill doesn't run itself. But for a friend of my brother's, I can spare a minute.
story.skycraft.npc.gurak.greet: Orsinium has been burned down more times than any city in Tamriel. It is still here. So am I.
story.skycraft.npc.hadvar.greet: I keep hearing that roar in my sleep. Whatever that thing was, the Legion will need every sword.
story.skycraft.npc.haelga.greet: Dibella blesses all who come to her with an open heart. Or an open purse.
story.skycraft.npc.harkon.greet: You stand in Castle Volkihar, mortal, and you still have your blood. Consider that a courtesy.
story.skycraft.npc.hlaalu_factor.greet: House Hlaalu deals in everything. Even information. Especially information.
story.skycraft.npc.irileth.greet: Keep your hands where I can see them. The Jarl has had enough surprises this year.
story.skycraft.npc.isran.greet: The Vigil of Stendarr failed. The Dawnguard won't. Vampires are getting bolder, and somebody has to be bolder still.
story.skycraft.npc.karliah.greet: Twenty-five years I've waited for someone to hear the truth. Sit, and listen.
story.skycraft.npc.keerava.greet: The Bee and Barb serves drink and food. Trouble, it does not serve.
story.skycraft.npc.kesh.greet: Kesh tends the Taskmaster's shrine. Kesh is clean. The others? Not so clean.
story.skycraft.npc.kodlak.greet: Jorrvaskr has stood longer than Whiterun's walls. We take work for coin and honor both, and we don't ask which a job pays in.
story.skycraft.npc.magister.greet: Alinor welcomes scholars. Barbarians, it merely tolerates. Which are you?
story.skycraft.npc.malborn.greet: I don't know you. Unless Delphine sent you, in which case, keep your voice down.
story.skycraft.npc.mane.greet: The Mane speaks for the moons and for every Khajiit under them. Speak plainly, and the Mane will listen.
story.skycraft.npc.maven.greet: If you're here to beg, the Temple of Mara is down the street. If you're here to work, sit down and close your mouth.
story.skycraft.npc.mercer.greet: Brynjolf vouches for you. That buys you a seat at the table. Keeping it is up to you.
story.skycraft.npc.mirabelle.greet: If you've lost your way, I can point you. If you've broken something, I'd rather know now.
story.skycraft.npc.nazir.greet: Contracts, coin and corpses. In that order, if we're lucky.
story.skycraft.npc.nelkir.greet: There's a door in the cellar that whispers. It tells me things about my father. Want to know what it says?
story.skycraft.npc.neloth.greet: If you're here to waste my time, do it efficiently. If not, you may be useful.
story.skycraft.npc.quaranir.greet: You've noticed me. Good. The Psijic Order watches; it seldom speaks. Today it speaks to you.
story.skycraft.npc.ralof.greet: Gerdur's cooking, a roof, and a dragon somewhere to the north. Talos keep us, what a day.
story.skycraft.npc.redoran_warden.greet: House Redoran keeps the ash at bay. Duty first. Speak quickly.
story.skycraft.npc.rikke.greet: Skyrim is my home too, whatever Ulfric says. The Legion is how we keep it whole.
story.skycraft.npc.sabjorn.greet: Honningbrew mead, best in the hold. Or it will be, once I get rid of these skeevers.
story.skycraft.npc.sam.greet: A drinking contest! Win, and I'll give you a staff that'll make you famous. Lose, and you buy.
story.skycraft.npc.savlian.greet: Kvatch was burned once, in the Oblivion Crisis. We rebuilt it. Now there's a gate in the hills again, and nobody wants to say it out loud.
story.skycraft.npc.savos_aren.greet: The College is a place of learning. I'd like it to remain one, whatever the Jarl and the townsfolk think of us.
story.skycraft.npc.septimus.greet: The box, the lock, the heart within... Hm? A visitor. How dreadfully interruptive.
story.skycraft.npc.serana.greet: I've been asleep a long time. Tell me the world hasn't changed too much. Actually, don't.
story.skycraft.npc.silus.greet: Welcome to the Museum of the Mythic Dawn! Mind the robes; some of them are original.
story.skycraft.npc.sinding.greet: Don't look at me like that. I'm locked up for a reason, and I'm not proud of it.
story.skycraft.npc.skjor.greet: Keep your blade sharp and your questions short.
story.skycraft.npc.spinner.greet: The Green Pact binds us: we do not cut the living wood, and we eat only flesh. Most outsiders find the second part harder.
story.skycraft.npc.storn.greet: I am the shaman of the Skaal. The wind has gone strange, and the stones cry out in a voice I don't know.
story.skycraft.npc.tharen.greet: The Tribunal walked among us once. Now we keep their temples, and the mountain keeps its secrets.
story.skycraft.npc.tolfdir.greet: Ah, a student! Or are you a visitor? Either way, there is always time for a lesson on wards.
story.skycraft.npc.tullius.greet: I have a war to win and a province full of people who'd rather I lost it. Make it quick.
story.skycraft.npc.tyranus.greet: There is something foul in that house. I can smell it. Help me cleanse it.
story.skycraft.npc.ulfric.greet: Skyrim belongs to the Nords. Speak, if you have something worth my time.
story.skycraft.npc.urag.greet: This is the Arcanaeum. Touch the books with clean hands and don't eat near them.
story.skycraft.npc.vex.greet: Don't touch anything. And don't talk to me unless it's about money.
story.skycraft.npc.viarmo.greet: Welcome to the Bards College, the oldest school of song in Skyrim. Mind the lute strings; they bite.
story.skycraft.npc.vilkas.greet: Another hopeful. Everyone wants to be a Companion until they learn what it costs.
story.skycraft.npc.yasmin.greet: In Hammerfell, a sword is a prayer. Most people pray badly.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.desc: Finn's lute lies in Dead Crone Rock, in the Forsworn-held hills of the Reach.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.o2.rep: Still in tune! Finn built well.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.o2.tex: Bring the lute to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.pitch: Finn's lute. A student took it into the Reach, to Dead Crone Rock. The Forsworn live there. Be careful.
story.skycraft.q.bards_finns_lute.title: Finn's Lute
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.des: Pantea Ateia's flute was lost in Ilinalta's Deep, a drowned fort on Lake Ilinalta.
She'll weep, and then she'll play. Thank you.
Bring the flute to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.off: Do you have any work for a bard?
story.skycraft.q.bards_panteas_flute.pit: Pantea lent her flute to an apprentice who took it to Ilinalta's Deep, on the lake. He never came back. The flute should.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.desc: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt, a ruin in the Reach overrun by hagravens.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.o2.re: All three instruments, home at last. The College owes you more than I can pay, but here's what I can.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.o2.te: Bring the drum to the Bards College
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.pitch: Rjorn's drum is in Hag Rock Redoubt. Hagravens. I'd go myself if I weren't a coward.
story.skycraft.q.bards_rjorns_drum.title: Rjorn's Drum
story.skycraft.q.bards_tending_the_flame: Viarmo, headmaster of the Bards College, wants King Olaf's lost verse from Dead Men's Respite, to win back the city's festival and give me my place at the College.
Take King Olaf's verse from his tomb
Half rotten and half in riddles. Perfect. I'll write the rest myself, and the Jarl will have her festival. Welcome to the College, bard.
King Olaf's verse. I have it.
How do I join the Bards College?
We'd need a reason to let you in. Here's one: the King Olaf's Fire festival is banned, unless I can show the Jarl the lost Edda of King Olaf. It's said to lie in Dead Men's Respite. Bring it back.
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.desc: Ancano has taken control of the Eye of Magnus. Wild magic is tearing through the College and the town of Winterhold.
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.o0.text: Return to the College of Winterhold
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.o2.repl: Savos... Savos is dead. Ancano did this. If you have found where the Staff of Magnus lies, go now. Nothing else can stop that Eye.
story.skycraft.q.col_containment.title: Containment
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.desc: With the Staff of Magnus I can drain the Eye's power and break Ancano's hold on it.
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.o2.re: The Order will take it, to a place where it will harm no one. Go and speak to Tolfdir. The College needs a new Arch-Mage, and I believe it has one.
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.o2.to: Ancano is dead. What about the Eye?
story.skycraft.q.col_eye_of_magnus.title: The Eye of Magnus
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.desc: Faralda let me across the bridge to the College of Winterhold. The Master Wizard, Mirabelle Ervine, will see me enrolled, and Tolfdir teaches the first lessons.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o0.te: Cross the bridge into the College of Winterhold
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o1.re: Another apprentice. Welcome. Your quarters are in the Hall of Attainment. Lessons start in the Hall of the Elements; Tolfdir is waiting there now.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.o2.re: Excellent! Wards. Remember: a ward is not a wall. It's a door you're holding shut. Hold it shut with your whole will. Now, I need help with a small excavation at Saarthal. You'll come, won't you?
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.offer: I want to join the College.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.pitch: Then show me you can do more than wave your hands. Cast any spell you know here, at the gate; the ward will tell me the rest. Then go inside and find Mirabelle.
story.skycraft.q.col_first_lessons.title: First Lessons
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.des: Savos Aren sent me to Mzulft to study the Dwemer Oculory, which might reveal where the Staff of Magnus lies.
Fight the Falmer and the machines of Mzulft
Light through the Oculory's lenses drew a map on the walls. The Staff of Magnus lies in Labyrinthian, and the light showed something else: a Thalmor agent had been here before me.
Take the focusing crystal from the Oculory
Labyrinthian. Of course. I went there once, as a young man, with friends. I was the only one to come out. Go carefully, and tell no one, least of all Ancano.
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.off: The books speak of the Staff of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_good_intentions.pit: The Psijic monk visited you again, didn't he? Go to Mzulft, the Dwemer ruin in Eastmarch. Their Oculory focused light the way the Eye focuses magic. Bring back what it shows.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.d: Urag gro-Shub says the books I need were stolen by a former student who fled to Fellglow Keep to join a circle of necromancers.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.o: Mostly without blood. This one speaks of a staff, the Staff of Magnus. If anything could tame that Eye, it's that. Read it here; don't take it away.
Here are your books, without blood.
I need books about the Eye of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_hitting_the_books.p: The ones you want aren't here. Orthorn, a student, ran off to Fellglow Keep with three of my best volumes as a gift for some necromancers. Get them back. And don't get blood on them.
story.skycraft.q.col_staff_of_magnus.des: The Staff of Magnus lies with the dragon priest Morokei in Labyrinthian, the ruined city where Savos Aren lost his friends long ago.
Fight through the halls of Labyrinthian
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.desc: Tolfdir is leading the College's excavation of Saarthal, the ancient Nord city near Winterhold. He asked me to help find anything of magical interest.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o1.t: Fight through the draugr of Saarthal
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o2.t: Search the ruins for magical artifacts
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o3.j: Beyond Jyrik Gauldurson's tomb we found an enormous orb of magic. Tolfdir thinks it may be the Eye of Magnus.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o4.r: And the Psijic Order appeared to you. They are not given to visits. Bring nothing more out of Saarthal without telling me, and say nothing to the Thalmor.
story.skycraft.q.col_under_saarthal.o4.t: We found something enormous under Saarthal.
Kodlak Whitemane died before he could be cured. The Circle carries his ashes and the restored Wuuthrad to Ysgramor's Tomb, to free his spirit from Hircine.
Fight through the tomb's restless guardians
Burn a witch head in the Flame of the Harbinger
Kodlak was right. I want to be free of the beast too.
Then it's done. Burn a head for yourself, and walk out of here as you came into the world.
The beast is part of me now. I'll keep it.
Your choice, Harbinger. The blood will serve you, if you master it and not the other way round.
Decide whether to keep the beast blood
Kodlak is dead. The Silver Hand's last raid. He wanted to be laid to rest in Ysgramor's Tomb, and free of the blood. We go north, all of us, with Wuuthrad.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.desc: Skjor sent me with Farkas to recover a fragment of Wuuthrad, Ysgramor's axe, from Dustman's Cairn.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o0.t: Travel to Dustman's Cairn with Farkas
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o1.j: Inside the cairn the Silver Hand were waiting for us. They knew about Farkas. They called him a beast.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o1.t: Fight off the Silver Hand ambush
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o2.t: Fight through the draugr of the inner crypt
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.o4.r: So Farkas told you, and you came back anyway. Good. Tonight, the Underforge. There is more to the Companions than steel.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.offe: Kodlak says you have a job for me.
story.skycraft.q.comp_proving_honor.pitc: A scholar came to us with rumor of a fragment of Wuuthrad in Dustman's Cairn. Take Farkas. If you come back with it, we'll talk about your future.
Kodlak wants to be free of the beast blood before he dies. The witches of Glenmoril Coven, who first gave the Companions their curse, hold the key to curing it.
Thank you, Shield-Sibling. I can feel Sovngarde already. When my time comes, burn one in Ysgramor's tomb and take me home.
Return to Kodlak with the witches' heads
The witches are dead. Here are their heads.
You wanted to see me, Harbinger?
I'm old, and I want to see Sovngarde, not Hircine's hunting grounds. The witches of Glenmoril Coven gave us this blood long ago. Bring me their heads, and we can burn the beast out of me.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.desc: Kodlak Whitemane, Harbinger of the Companions, is willing to consider me for a place at Jorrvaskr. First, the others want to see me fight.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.re: Fine. Not with me; I'd rather not spoil my afternoon. Go out there and put down something that deserves it, then come back.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.te: Talk to Vilkas in the training yard
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o0.to: Kodlak says I'm to prove myself.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o1.te: Prove yourself: kill three bandits or beasts
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o2.re: Hm. Not bad. Now take my sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge and ask him to sharpen it. Every whelp runs errands; you're a whelp.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.re: Of course he did. Here, take this shield to Aela while you're at it. Welcome to Jorrvaskr, whelp.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.te: Take Vilkas's sword to Eorlund at the Skyforge
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o3.to: Vilkas asked me to bring you his sword.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.o4.re: Good. You're one of us now, as far as the hall is concerned. Don't get comfortable.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.offer: I'd like to join the Companions.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.pitch: Join? Let me look at you. Vilkas, take our guest out to the yard and see what kind of arm they have.
story.skycraft.q.comp_take_up_arms.title: Take Up Arms
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.de: Skjor offered me the Circle's gift: the blood of the beast. And then the Silver Hand, the hunters who track werewolves for sport, killed Skjor. Aela wants Gallows Rock burned to the ground.
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o0: Wait for nightfall, then go to the Underforge beneath the Skyforge
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o2: Now we hunt the ones who hunt us. Skjor went after them alone and they killed him. Gallows Rock. Tonight.
story.skycraft.q.comp_the_silver_hand.o6: Then they died a day too early to do it. Skjor is avenged. Kodlak will want to see you; he has other things on his mind.
Show Aela the Silver Hand's orders
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.de: Falion, the wizard of Morthal, can cure my vampirism with an old ritual. He needs a black soul gem, and the ritual must be done at dawn at the summoning circle outside Morthal.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o0: Good. Go to the summoning circle east of town and wait for first light. I'll be there before you.
Bring Falion a black soul gem
I have the black soul gem.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o1: Go to the summoning circle outside Morthal
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o2: Wait for dawn at the summoning circle
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.o3: Then kneel in the circle, and let the sun see you.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.of: I've heard you know a cure for vampirism.
story.skycraft.q.curse_rising_at_dawn.pi: I do, and I'll not ask how you came by the need. Bring me a black soul gem, then meet me at the summoning circle outside town at dawn. The soul pays for the ritual, not you.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_battle_whiter: The Stormcloaks are attacking Whiterun. The Legion holds the walls.
Join the defenders at Whiterun's gate
It did, and so did you. Now we take the fight to them, fort by fort. Come to me when you're ready to march.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.desc: The Legion marches on Windhelm, Ulfric Stormcloak's capital, to end the rebellion.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.o1.te: Fight through the defenders of Windhelm
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.o2.te: Defeat Ulfric Stormcloak in the Palace of the Kings
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.offer: Is it time to finish this?
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.pitch: It's time. Windhelm. Ulfric's own city. We break the gate, we take the palace, and we end this rebellion in one day.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_capital.title: The Battle for Windhelm
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.desc: Legate Rikke sent me to seize a Stormcloak fort. If it falls, the hold it guards comes over to the Empire.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.offer: Which fort do we take next?
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.pitch: The rebels hold a fort that guards a whole hold. Take it, and the hold is ours. I'll send a squad to meet you there.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_fort.title: Reunification of Skyrim
The Jagged Crown of the ancient High Kings lies in Korvanjund. If Ulfric gets it, he'll be crowned High King. Legate Rikke wants it first.
Drive the Stormcloaks out of Korvanjund
Ugly thing. Priceless, though, to the right fools. Ulfric won't be wearing it. Now, Whiterun. Balgruuf has sat on the fence long enough.
Bring the crown to General Tullius
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.desc: Legate Rikke will enlist me in the Imperial Legion once I've cleared bandits out of Fort Hraggstad.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.o1.text: Clear the bandits out of Fort Hraggstad
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.o2.reply: Then raise your hand and swear it. Welcome to the Imperial Legion, soldier. Here's your kit. Don't get blood on the collar.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.offer: I want to join the Legion.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.pitch: Good. Before I sign you up: Fort Hraggstad has been taken over by bandits, and we need it back. Clear it out, and come back.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_join.title: Joining the Legion
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.desc: General Tullius wants Jarl Balgruuf to accept a Legion garrison in Whiterun. I'm to deliver the demand.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.o0.re: A garrison. And if I refuse, the Stormcloaks march on me anyway. Very well. Whiterun stands with the Empire. Tell Tullius to send his soldiers quickly; Ulfric's are already coming.
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.o0.te: Deliver General Tullius's letter to Jarl Balgruuf
story.skycraft.q.cw_legion_message.title: Message to Whiterun
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_battle_whiteru: Balgruuf refused. The Stormcloaks march on Whiterun.
Join the army at the Stormcloak camp near Whiterun
Ha! Whiterun is ours! Now we drive them back to their forts and burn them out one by one.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.desc: The Stormcloaks march on Solitude, the seat of Imperial power in Skyrim.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.o1.tex: Fight through the defenders of Solitude
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.o2.tex: Defeat General Tullius in Castle Dour
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.offer: Is it time to take Solitude?
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.pitch: It's time. Solitude, the Empire's last stronghold. We take the city, we take Castle Dour, and Tullius goes back to Cyrodiil in a box.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_capital.title: The Battle for Solitude
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.desc: Galmar sent me to seize an Imperial fort. If it falls, the hold it guards goes over to the Stormcloaks.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.offer: Which Imperial fort do we hit next?
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.pitch: There's a Legion fort squatting over one of our holds. Take it, and that hold is free. I'll have brothers waiting for you there.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_fort.title: Liberation of Skyrim
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_jagged_crown.d: The Jagged Crown of the ancient High Kings lies in Korvanjund. Ulfric means to wear it. The Legion means to stop him.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_jagged_crown.o: Drive the Legion out of Korvanjund
The crown of Skyrim's kings. Not mine yet; it must be earned. But this will put fire in every Nord's chest. Now: Whiterun.
Bring the crown to Ulfric Stormcloak
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.desc: Galmar Stone-Fist will take me into the Stormcloak army once I've killed an ice wraith haunting a ruin in the snow.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.o2.reply: Ha! Then raise your blade and swear it. You're a Stormcloak now. Fight for Skyrim, and Sovngarde will know your name.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.offer: I want to fight for the Stormcloaks.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.pitch: Talk is cheap. There's an ice wraith in the old redoubt north of here that's been killing travelers. Bring me its teeth.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_join.title: Joining the Stormcloaks
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.desc: Ulfric sends Jarl Balgruuf an axe. If Balgruuf keeps it, he stands with Ulfric. If he sends it back, it means war.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.o0.rep: An axe. Subtle, as always. Take it back to him. Whiterun is not his to command. If he wants it, he can come and take it.
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.o0.tex: Deliver Ulfric's axe to Jarl Balgruuf
story.skycraft.q.cw_storm_message.title: Message to Whiterun
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.desc: Azura's priestess Aranea Ienith says the Lady of Dusk and Dawn wants her Star cleansed. A sorcerer has corrupted it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o3.text: Destroy Malyn Varen's soul within the Star
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.reply: Azura smiles on you. The Star is yours. It will hold any soul, endlessly, and never break.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.text: Return the cleansed Star to Aranea
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.o4.topic: Varen is gone. The Star is clean.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.offer: Who are you waiting for out here?
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.pitch: For you, it seems. Azura has shown me your face. She has a task for you. Kneel at the shrine, and listen.
story.skycraft.q.dae_azura.title: The Black Star
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.desc: The cultists of Boethiah serve a Prince of betrayal and murder. She wants a new champion, and the old one must die.
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.pitch: A champion. Hers is weak. Climb to the Sacellum, let the Prince speak to you, and then kill the one she names.
story.skycraft.q.dae_boethiah.title: Boethiah's Calling
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.desc: A talking dog named Barbas found me near Falkreath. He says he's lost his master, the Daedric Prince Clavicus Vile, and wants me to help him get home.
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.o0.text: Follow the talking dog through Falkreath
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.o2.text: Clear the vampires out of Haemar's Shame
story.skycraft.q.dae_clavicus.title: A Daedra's Best Friend
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.desc: Septimus Signus wants me to open a Dwemer lockbox deep under Blackreach for his master, Hermaeus Mora.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.o1.text: Destroy the guardian of the Dwemer lockbox
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.offer: Is there something else beneath the ice, Septimus?
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.pitch: A box! A Dwemer box, sealed in the deeps, and what's inside it belongs to my master. Open it, bring me the Oghma. Bring it, bring it, bring it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hermaeus.title: Discerning the Transmundane
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.desc: Sinding, a werewolf jailed in Falkreath, stole the Ring of Hircine. Now the Lord of the Hunt wants a hunt.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.pitch: I killed a girl. Not me. The beast. I took a ring that was supposed to help me control it, and Hircine cursed it. He'll come for me. Unless you hunt me first.
story.skycraft.q.dae_hircine.title: Ill Met by Moonlight
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.desc: The orcs of Largashbur are cursed. Their shaman Atub thinks Malacath wants an outsider's help.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o0.text: Kill a troll and take its fat
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o1.reply: Now place your hands on the shrine. He will speak.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o1.text: Bring the troll fat to Atub
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.o2.text: Kill the giant chieftain who mocks Largashbur
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.pitch: Malacath has turned from us. Our chief will not beg. You could. Bring troll fat to the shrine, and listen to what the Furious One wants.
story.skycraft.q.dae_malacath.title: The Cursed Tribe
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.desc: Silus Vesuius, a collector of Mythic Dawn relics, wants me to gather the three pieces of Mehrunes' Razor.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o0.text: Recover the Razor's hilt from Cracked Tusk Keep
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o1.text: Recover the Razor's blade shards from Cliffside Retreat
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o2.text: Recover the Razor's pommel from Morvunskar
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.o3.text: Meet Silus at the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.pitch: The Mythic Dawn, the cult that opened the gates of Oblivion! And I want the one thing missing from my collection: Mehrunes' Razor. It was broken into three pieces. Find them, and we'll meet at the shrine.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mehrunes.title: Pieces of the Past
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.desc: The Jarl's son Nelkir hears a whispering door in Dragonsreach's cellar. Behind it, the Daedric Prince Mephala's blade sleeps.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.reply: That door? The Jarl had it sealed for good reason. Fine. Take the key. I didn't give it to you.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.text: Get the key to the Whispering Door from Farengar
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o0.topic: I need the key to the cellar door.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.o2.text: Take Mephala's blade from the stand
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.pitch: It knows secrets. About my father, and about you. And it says there's a blade behind it, if somebody gets the key from Farengar. I can't. You can.
story.skycraft.q.dae_mephala.title: The Whispering Door
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.desc: I found a glowing beacon in a chest, and it pulls toward the Statue to Meridia on the coast of Haafingar.
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.o0.text: Bring the beacon to the Statue to Meridia
story.skycraft.q.dae_meridia.title: The Break of Dawn
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.desc: A Vigilant of Stendarr asked me to help purge an abandoned house in Markarth. The Prince of Domination is waiting inside.
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o0.text: Enter the Abandoned House with the Vigilant
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.o1.text: Bring Molag Bal's judgment to Logrolf the Willful
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.pitch: It belongs to a Daedric Prince now. Molag Bal, I think. Come in with me. Whatever happens, keep your sword drawn.
story.skycraft.q.dae_molag.title: The House of Horrors
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.desc: A woman named Eola in Markarth wants my help reclaiming Reachcliff Cave for Namira's followers.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o1.text: Clear the draugr from Reachcliff Cave
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c0.label: I'll join the feast.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c0.reply: Then you're one of us. Wear this, and never fear hunger again.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c1.label: No. This ends now.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.o2.c1.reply: Pity. Namira will remember your refusal. Take this, anyway. She likes a bold palate, even a disappointing one.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.pitch: A feast of a kind few have the stomach for. First, Reachcliff Cave has been overrun by draugr. Clear it, and we'll talk about dinner.
story.skycraft.q.dae_namira.title: The Taste of Death
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.desc: Kesh the Clean needs vampire dust and silver to burn the incense that lets Peryite speak.
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.pitch: Kesh needs ingredients to speak with the Taskmaster. Bring vampire dust and a silver ingot. Then breathe the smoke, and listen.
story.skycraft.q.dae_peryite.title: The Only Cure
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.desc: I accepted a drinking contest from a stranger named Sam Guevenne. I don't remember much after the third mug.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o0.text: Match Sam mug for mug (bring three bottles of Nord Mead)
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o0.topic: Three for you, three for me.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o2.reply: What didn't? You were a legend. I'm Sanguine, by the way. Sorry about the mess. Here, you've earned this.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.o2.text: Talk to Sam at Misty Grove
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.pitch: Ha! Drink up. Here, this one's on me. And this one. And this one...
story.skycraft.q.dae_sanguine.title: A Night to Remember
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.desc: A madman in Solitude says his master, Sheogorath, is lost inside the mind of a long-dead emperor, and the way in is the sealed Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.pitch: Sheogorath! The Mad God! He went into Pelagius's mind, and Pelagius has been dead for centuries! Go to the Pelagius Wing of the Blue Palace and fetch him out.
story.skycraft.q.dae_sheogorath.title: The Mind of Madness
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.desc: Dawnstar is plagued by nightmares. Erandur, a priest of Mara who once served Vaermina, wants to cleanse the Nightcaller Temple.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o0.text: Go to the Nightcaller Temple with Erandur
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o3.c0.repl: Thank you. Mara's mercy on us both. Dawnstar will sleep tonight.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.o3.c1.repl: Then you're no better than I was. Go, and may Mara forgive you.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.pitch: Vaermina. Her priests were sealed in the Nightcaller Temple long ago with something that feeds on dreams. The seal is breaking. Come with me, and we'll end it.
story.skycraft.q.dae_vaermina.title: Waking Nightmare
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.de: The Emperor's cousin, Vittoria Vici, is to be married in Solitude. A wedding is a fine place for a funeral.
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o0: Travel to Solitude for the wedding
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o1: Kill Vittoria Vici during her wedding
story.skycraft.q.db_bound_until_death.o2: And the Empire will be crying into its wine for a week. Good. Next, the Emperor himself.
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.desc: The Penitus Oculatus, the Emperor's guards, found the Sanctuary. Astrid betrayed us to save herself, and they killed her anyway.
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.o1.t: Kill the Penitus Oculatus agents in the Sanctuary
story.skycraft.q.db_death_incarnate.o3.r: Now? Now we finish the contract. The Emperor's ship is docked at Solitude. We go in, we kill him, we disappear. Sithis is watching.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.desc: The Emperor's ship, the Katariah, lies at anchor off Solitude. It is time to fulfill the contract of the age.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o0.text: Board the Katariah at the Solitude Docks
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o2.s0: Titus Mede II, Emperor of Tamriel
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.o3.reply: Hail Sithis! The Dark Brotherhood lives, and you, Listener, are its heart. Here's your share. It's a big share.
story.skycraft.q.db_hail_sithis.title: Hail Sithis!
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.desc: A boy in Windhelm, Aventus Aretino, has been performing the Black Sacrament to summon an assassin. He wants Grelod the Kind, who runs the orphanage in Riften, dead.
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.o2.re: Really? She's really dead? Then the Night Mother heard me. Here, it's all I have. Thank you. Thank you!
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.o2.te: Tell Aventus Aretino that Grelod is dead
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.pitch: I've been doing the Black Sacrament. Grelod the Kind runs the Honorhall orphanage in Riften, and there's nothing kind about her. Please. Kill her. I'll give you everything I have.
story.skycraft.q.db_innocence_lost.title: Innocence Lost
story.skycraft.q.db_whispers_in_the_dark: Cicero, the Keeper of the Night Mother's coffin, has been listening to her for years and hearing nothing. Then she spoke, and she spoke to me.
Because she spoke to you! Listen, listen! She wants you to go!
Speak to Cicero beside the Night Mother
Why are you staring at me?
Then here is the contract, and it is not a small one. Titus Mede the Second. The Emperor. He arrives in Skyrim soon. Take the letter to your Sanctuary, and seal the deal.
The Emperor. The Brotherhood hasn't had a contract like this since the Mythic Dawn. Before we strike, we take care of the people close to him.
The Emperor. We're to kill the Emperor.
story.skycraft.q.db_with_friends_like_th: I took a contract that belonged to the Dark Brotherhood, and the Brotherhood noticed. I woke up in an abandoned shack with three bound prisoners and a woman named Astrid.
Kill one of the three hooded captives
Not a moment's hesitation. Welcome to the family. Our Sanctuary is in the pine forest near Falkreath. The password is 'Silence, my brother.'
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.desc: Isran sent me to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are digging for.
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.o2.reply: Serana. Please, no more questions. I need to get home to Castle Volkihar. My family will want to know I'm awake.
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.o3.text: Take Serana home to Castle Volkihar
story.skycraft.q.dg_awakening.title: Awakening
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.desc: Serana's family are the vampires of Castle Volkihar, and her father, Lord Harkon, has something to offer me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o0.c0.repl: Then drink, and rise as a lord of the night. Serana will guide you. We have a prophecy to fulfill.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o0.c1.repl: A pity. Leave my hall while I'm still in a generous mood. Serana stays with me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.reply: A prophecy, and an Elder Scroll, and a vampire girl who wants to help us. Fine. I'll take any weapon I can get. Find a Moth Priest to read that Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.text: Report to Isran at Fort Dawnguard
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.o1.topic: Volkihar's lord wants to blot out the sun.
story.skycraft.q.dg_bloodline.title: Bloodline
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.desc: Serana's mother, Valerica, fled into the Soul Cairn with the second Elder Scroll. The portal is in the courtyard of Castle Volkihar.
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.o0.te: Open the portal in Castle Volkihar's courtyard
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.o2.jo: With the Keeper destroyed, Valerica gave up the second Elder Scroll, and I left the Soul Cairn before it could keep me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_chasing_echoes.title: Chasing Echoes
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.desc: A guard told me of a new order of vampire hunters, the Dawnguard, gathering at an old fort in the Dayspring Canyon near Riften. Vampires are bold enough to attack towns now.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o1.reply: Good, because I'm not turning anyone away. There's a crypt, Dimhollow, where the vampires have been digging. I want to know why. Go.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o1.topic: I want to join the Dawnguard.
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.o2.text: Help drive off the vampires testing the fort's walls
story.skycraft.q.dg_dawnguard.title: Dawnguard
story.skycraft.q.dg_kindred_judgment.des: With Auriel's bow, Harkon can be stopped before he blots out the sun. Castle Volkihar is where it ends.
It is. Keep the bow. It's yours by every right that matters. And if you need a companion who doesn't mind the dark, you know where to find me.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.desc: Serana's Elder Scroll holds part of Harkon's prophecy. A Moth Priest, Dexion Evicus, is traveling near Dragon Bridge and could read it.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o0.text: Find the Moth Priest near Dragon Bridge
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o1.text: Kill the vampires holding the Moth Priest
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o2.reply: Free? And a Scroll to read, my reward for it. Take me to your fort, and bring me an ancestor moth swarm from the glade near Falkreath; I'll need their light.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o2.topic: You're free. We need you to read a Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o4.text: Gather ancestor moths in the Ancestor Glade
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.o5.reply: Then I read. 'Amongst the Vale lies the bow of Auriel, which with blood made dark will darken the sun.' And there is a second Scroll. It lies with Serana's mother.
story.skycraft.q.dg_prophet.title: Prophet
story.skycraft.q.dg_touching_the_sky.des: Both Scrolls point to the Forgotten Vale, a hidden valley beyond Darkfall Cave, where the Snow Elves kept Auriel's bow.
Find the way into the Forgotten Vale
Fight through the Falmer of the Vale
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.desc: With the Elder Scroll I return to the summit of the Throat of the World. At the time-wound, where Alduin was cast out long ago, the Scroll will show me the Shout I need.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o0.te: Return to the summit of the Throat of the World
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o1.te: Read the Elder Scroll at the time-wound
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.o3.jo: Grounded by Dragonrend, Alduin fought like a cornered wolf, and when he was beaten he fled into the sky. He is not dead. Not yet.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_bane.title: Alduin's Bane
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.desc: Esbern believes Alduin's Wall, carved in the lost Sky Haven Temple, shows how the ancient Nords defeated the World-Eater. The temple lies hidden inside Karthspire, in the Reach, where the Forsworn now camp.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o0.te: Meet Delphine and Esbern at Karthspire
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o1.te: Clear the Forsworn camp at Karthspire
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o3.re: Look, look! The heroes didn't kill him. They cast him out of time, with a Shout made for the purpose.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o4.re: Then go. Take this blade from the old Blades' armory: it was forged for exactly this kind of work. You're one of us now, whatever the Greybeards say.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.o4.to: We have to ask the Greybeards about Dragonrend.
story.skycraft.q.main_alduins_wall.title: Alduin's Wall
story.skycraft.q.main_before_the_storm.d: The dragon flew north toward Whiterun. Riverwood asked me to carry word to Jarl Balgruuf and beg him for soldiers; the village has no walls and no garrison.
story.skycraft.q.main_before_the_storm.o: The Jarl sent soldiers to Riverwood. He has another task for me, something about his court wizard and dragons.

A dragon? So the rumors are true. Irileth, send a detachment to Riverwood at once. You've done Whiterun a service, friend. Stay a moment. My court wizard has a task that wants someone with your nerve.
Speak to Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach
Riverwood needs protection. A dragon destroyed Helgen.
Delphine is one of the last Blades, the order that once guarded the Dragonborn emperors. She thinks the dragons are not returning on their own: something is raising them from their mounds. Kynesgrove is next on her map.
That map Farengar copied for me marks every burial mound in Skyrim. If I'm right, a dragon will rise from the one at Kynesgrove. Meet me there. Bring your Voice.
What do you know about the dragons?
By Alduin himself. The World-Eater, out of the old prophecies. I hoped it was a story. The Thalmor will know something; they always do. I have a way into their embassy.
So the dragons are being raised.
story.skycraft.q.main_bleak_falls_barrow: Farengar Secret-Fire, the Jarl's court wizard, believes there is a record of the dragons' resting places carved on a tablet in Bleak Falls Barrow, the old tomb on the mountain above Riverwood.
Help is a strong word. I need legs. In Bleak Falls Barrow lies a carved tablet: the Dragonstone. It maps their burial mounds, I'm sure of it. Bring it to me and the Jarl will pay you.
Speak to Farengar about the Dragonstone
The Jarl says you need help with dragons.
The dead don't stay down in Bleak Falls Barrow. I put four of them back in their alcoves.
Behind the overlord's sarcophagus stood a curved wall carved in claw-marks. One of the marks burned and I knew it: FUS. Force. I can't make it mean anything yet.
Defeat the Draugr Overlord guarding the inner chamber
Take the Dragonstone from the overlord's tomb
Remarkable. A map of mounds, every one marked. My colleague will be delighted. And you should go to the Jarl; a guard just came in shouting about the western watchtower.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.desc: Esbern, an archivist of the Blades, is hiding somewhere in the Ratway beneath Riften. The Thalmor are looking for him too.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.re: An old man jumping at shadows? Lad, half the Ratway fits that. But there's one locked in the Warrens like he owes the world money. Watch yourself down there; you're not the only one asking.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.te: Ask around Riften about the old man in the Ratway
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o1.to: I'm looking for an old man hiding in the Ratway.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o3.te: Deal with the Thalmor hunting Esbern
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o4.re: Delphine? Alive? Then the world isn't entirely lost. Alduin has come back, and nothing can stop him but a Dragonborn. Take me to her. I know where the Blades hid their secrets.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o4.te: Find Esbern in the Ratway Warrens
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o5.te: Bring Esbern to Delphine in Riverwood
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.o6.re: Old fool, I thought you dead. Esbern says the lost Sky Haven Temple holds Alduin's Wall, the Blades' record of how he was beaten. It's in Karthspire, in the Reach. We go now.
story.skycraft.q.main_cornered_rat.title: A Cornered Rat
story.skycraft.q.main_diplomatic_immunit: Delphine is sure the Thalmor know who is raising the dragons. Their embassy outside Solitude holds a reception tonight, and a friend of the Blades works in the kitchen.
Keep your voice down. I'll smuggle your gear into the embassy kitchen. Get in, find their files, get out. If anyone asks, you've never met me.
The Thalmor don't know who raises the dragons either. But they are hunting an old Blade named Esbern, and their file says he hides in the Ratway beneath Riften.
Search the embassy for the Thalmor's files
But they're hunting Esbern. If that old man is still alive, he knows more about Alduin than anyone living. Find him in the Ratway before they do.
The Thalmor are as lost as we are.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.desc: A dragon attacked the western watchtower. The Jarl sent his housecarl Irileth with a band of guards, and asked me to go with them. If a dragon can die, we will learn it today.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o0.t: Join Irileth at the western watchtower
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o2.j: When the dragon died, its soul poured into me. The guards say only the Dragonborn of legend could do that.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o3.r: Then the old tales are true. And did you hear the mountain? The Greybeards called a name from High Hrothgar, and I believe it was yours. By my right as Jarl, I name you Thane of Whiterun. Take this axe from my armory. And go to them: one does not keep the Greybeards waiting.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragon_rising.o3.t: The dragon is dead, and I took its soul.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.desc: The World-Eater is no more. Paarthurnax will want to hear it from me, on the mountain where it began.
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.o0.te: Return to the Throat of the World
story.skycraft.q.main_dragonslayer.title: Dragonslayer
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.de: I need an Elder Scroll. The only person in Skyrim who might know where one lies is Septimus Signus, a scholar of the Scrolls who lives alone in the ice north of Winterhold.
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o0: Find Septimus Signus north of Winterhold
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o1: The Scroll! Under the earth, in the Dwemer's hidden city, it waits inside the Tower of Mzark. Go down through Alftand into Blackreach. Take this sphere; the tower will listen to it.
Ask Septimus about the Elder Scroll
I'm looking for an Elder Scroll.
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o3: Survive the Falmer and the machines of Alftand
story.skycraft.q.main_elder_knowledge.o6: The tower's lenses focused a beam of starlight, and a cylinder rose from the floor. Inside lay an Elder Scroll.
Take the Elder Scroll from the tower's lens
story.skycraft.q.main_horn_of_jurgen.des: The Greybeards' final trial: recover the horn of their founder from his tomb in Ustengrav, deep in the bogs of Hjaalmarch.
Fight through the depths of Ustengrav
The horn was gone. Someone had beaten me to it and left a note: 'If you want the horn, rent the attic room at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood. Your friend.'
Go to the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood
The attic? We don't have... Close the door. So you're the one the Greybeards were shouting for. Here's your horn. I needed to see who'd come for it before I trusted them with anything.
Ask the innkeeper about the attic room
I'd like to rent the attic room.
You have passed the trials. Stand with us, and receive the last word of Force: DAH. Push. Let your Voice break what stands before it.
Return the horn to the Greybeards
Here is the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.desc: Delphine and Esbern have learned what Paarthurnax is. They demand his death as the price of the Blades' help.
I won't kill him. He taught me, and he's earned his peace.
Then the Blades have nothing more to say to you. I hope you're right about him.
Good. Esbern will see to it that the Blades remember this.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.offer: You look like you want to say something, Delphine.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.pitch: I'll say it plainly. Paarthurnax is a dragon. He was Alduin's lieutenant once, and he did unspeakable things. The Blades will not help you again until he's dead.
story.skycraft.q.main_paarthurnax.title: Paarthurnax
I agreed to kill Paarthurnax at the Blades' demand. He waits on the summit, as he always has.
Then the Blades stand with you again, Dragonborn. Some debts take a thousand years to collect.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.de: The civil war gets in the way of the fight against Alduin. Arngeir agreed to host a council at High Hrothgar, if both sides come.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o0: A truce with that rebel? ...If it frees my soldiers to fight dragons, I'll listen. I promise nothing.
Persuade General Tullius to attend the council
The Greybeards are holding a council. You should be there.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o1: I'd sooner not sit at a table with the Empire's dog. But I owe the Greybeards that much. I'll come.
Persuade Jarl Ulfric to attend the council
The Greybeards want both sides at High Hrothgar.
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.o2: Return to High Hrothgar for the council
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.of: Could the Greybeards host a truce between Ulfric and Tullius?
story.skycraft.q.main_season_unending.pi: This is a strange request to bring to High Hrothgar. But if the war hinders the fight against Alduin, we will open our doors. Bring them here. Let them talk.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.desc: Sovngarde. The mist here is Alduin's: he hunts the souls of the dead as they arrive. The heroes who first cast him out wait in the Hall of Valor.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.o2.journ: Alduin is gone. His soul broke apart over Sovngarde like sparks on the wind.
story.skycraft.q.main_sovngarde.title: Sovngarde
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.desc: Alduin fled to Sovngarde, through a portal no mortal can reach on foot. Paarthurnax says one of Alduin's own dragons could carry me, if I could trap one. Dragonsreach was built to hold a dragon once. Jarl Balgruuf will need persuading.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.repl: You want me to invite a dragon into my palace? ...You've never asked me for anything, and you saved this city once already. Very well. The great porch, and the old yoke. Gods help us.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.text: Ask Jarl Balgruuf to let you trap a dragon in Dragonsreach
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o0.topi: I need Dragonsreach to trap a dragon.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o1.text: Learn from Paarthurnax which dragon to call
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o2.text: Go to the great porch of Dragonsreach and call the dragon's name
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o3.jour: Odahviing came, and when he was spent the yoke slammed shut over his neck. Trapped, he offered a bargain.
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.o3.text: Wear Odahviing down until he can be caught in the yoke
story.skycraft.q.main_the_fallen.title: The Fallen
story.skycraft.q.main_throat_of_the_worl: Arngeir must tell me about Dragonrend, though the Greybeards will not thank me for keeping company with the Blades.

That Shout was made from hatred, and we will not teach it. Our master may answer you. Paarthurnax dwells on the summit. Take this Shout to part the winds that guard the path: LOK VAH KOOR. Clear Skies.
Use Clear Skies to part the storm on the path to the summit
Climb to the summit of the Throat of the World
Paarthurnax, master of the Greybeards, is a dragon. He says Dragonrend can only be learned by seeing it, through an Elder Scroll read at the time-wound on this summit.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.desc: I was caught crossing the border and carted to Helgen with a band of rebels to lose my head. Then the sky split open and a black dragon came down on the town. I have to get out.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c0.labe: I'm with you, Ralof. Lead the way.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c0.repl: Then stay close and keep low. The keep's this way, and the Legion won't hold the door for us.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c1.labe: Hadvar! Get me out of here.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.c1.repl: Follow me, prisoner. I'll cut those bindings once we're inside the keep. Move!
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.journal: With the headsman's block still wet and the dragon tearing the town apart, I picked a side and ran.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o0.text: Choose whom to follow out of Helgen: Ralof or Hadvar
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o1.journal: Inside the keep, soldiers of the other side stood between us and the tunnels. We cut our way through, and the spiders in the deep caves were worse.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o1.text: Fight your way through Helgen Keep
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o2.journal: We came out into daylight just as the dragon flew north over the mountains.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o2.text: Escape through the caves beneath the keep
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c0.labe: Ralof sent me. Helgen is gone. A dragon burned it.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c0.repl: A dragon? Shor's bones. Then Riverwood is next and we have no walls. Take what you need from the mill. And go to Whiterun, tell the Jarl we need soldiers.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c1.labe: Hadvar sent me. A dragon destroyed Helgen.
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.c1.repl: Hadvar's alive, thank the Nine. Here, take some iron from the forge and something to eat. Someone has to warn Jarl Balgruuf. Will you go?
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.o4.text: Find help in Riverwood: Ralof's sister Gerdur, or Hadvar's uncle Alvor
story.skycraft.q.main_unbound.title: Unbound
story.skycraft.q.main_way_of_the_voice.d: The Greybeards have summoned me to High Hrothgar, their monastery high on the Throat of the World. The pilgrims' road starts at Ivarstead: seven thousand steps cut into the mountain.
story.skycraft.q.main_way_of_the_voice.o: Begin the climb of the Seven Thousand Steps
So. A Dragonborn appears in our time. Let us see whether the blood speaks true. Show us your Voice.
Use Unrelenting Force before the Greybeards
Use Whirlwind Sprint to pass the gate in the courtyard
Then hear it. In the barrow of Ustengrav lies the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller, founder of our order. Bring it to us. The way is long and the dead do not sleep there.
Ask Arngeir about the final trial
I'm ready for the last trial.
Odahviing agreed to carry me to Skuldafn, a temple in the eastern mountains where Alduin's portal to Sovngarde stands. In return, I set him free.
Fight through the temple of Skuldafn
Open the portal with the dragon priest's staff and step through
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.desc: The Root Hist of Black Marsh is blighted and robbed by sap-thieves. Deeja-Sleeps of Stormhold wants pure sap saved before the tree sickens.
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.o0.text: Find the Root Hist in the deep marsh
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.o1.text: Drive off the sap-thieves and the blighted beasts
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.o2.text: Gather pure sap from the Root Hist
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.o3.reply: The Hist will heal. And it will remember you. When an Argonian says that, walker, it is not a small thing.
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.o3.topic: Pure sap from the Root Hist.
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.pitch: A blight. It creeps up the roots of the Root Hist in the deep marsh, and sap-thieves bleed the trees while they are weak. Go to the Root Hist. Bring back sap that is still pure.
story.skycraft.q.prov_bm_hist.title: The Hist Remembers
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.desc: An Oblivion gate has opened above Kvatch, echoing the Crisis that once burned the city. Savlian Matius of the city watch needs someone to go through it and close it.
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o0.text: Go to the Oblivion gate above Kvatch
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o1.text: Kill the dremora guarding the gate
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o3.text: Defeat the Sigil Keeper atop the gate's tower
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o4.repl: Closed. Just like the Hero of Kvatch did it, two hundred years ago. Kvatch owes you, and Kvatch pays its debts.
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o4.text: Bring the Sigil Stone to Savlian Matius
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.o4.topi: The gate is closed. Here's what held it open.
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.pitch: A gate. In the hills. Two hundred years after the Crisis, an Oblivion gate is open again above Kvatch. Somebody has to close it before what's behind it comes through.
story.skycraft.q.prov_cyr_kvatch.title: Echoes of Kvatch
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.desc: Dark spirits haunt the Temple of the Two Moons. Moon-Priest Azadhi asked me to cleanse it by moonlight and carry word to the Mane.
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.o0.text: Travel to the Temple of the Two Moons
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.o1.text: Wait for the moons to rise
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.o4.reply: The Mane felt it, the moment the light returned. You are not of the moons, and yet you served them. Elsweyr remembers its friends.
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.o4.text: Present the Lattice offering to the Mane in Riverhold
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.o4.topic: The moons dance again over the temple.
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.pitch: The Temple of the Two Moons has been desecrated by the Dro-m'Athra, the lost spirits. The Lunar Lattice cannot hold the moons' light while they haunt it. Cleanse the temple by night, when the moons can see you.
story.skycraft.q.prov_els_moons.title: Moons and Mane
story.skycraft.q.prov_ham_sword_singer.d: Yasmin at-Sentinel offered to test me in the way of the Yokudan sword-singers: claim an ancestral blade from the Ra Gada tomb and win a duel at Hel Ra Citadel.
story.skycraft.q.prov_ham_sword_singer.o: Travel to the Tomb of the Ra Gada
Lay the tomb's restless guardians to rest
Defeat the rival ansei in a duel
Then your blade sang, and you heard it. Keep it. A shehai is never given, only earned, and you have earned this one.
How does one become a sword-singer?
story.skycraft.q.prov_ham_sword_singer.p: You don't, not in one lifetime. But you can earn a shehai. Go to the tomb of the Ra Gada, the first warriors who sailed from Yokuda. Take an ancestor's blade, if its guardians let you. Then a rival waits at Hel Ra.
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.desc: King Gurak gro-Morkul of Orsinium tests outsiders who would be friends of the Orcs: feed the forges, then kill the ogre of Wrothgar Peak.
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.o0.tex: Bring ten iron ingots for Orsinium's forges
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.o3.tex: Kill the ogre of Wrothgar Peak
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.o4.rep: Then the clans will sing of a pink-skin who climbed Wrothgar. Badly, but they'll sing. Orsinium's gates are open to you, blood-kin.
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.o4.tex: Bring the ogre's tusk to King Gurak
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.pitch: Iron, for the forges. And a monster dead, for the clans to see. Bring ten bars of iron to the stronghold forge, then climb Wrothgar Peak and kill the ogre that eats our goats.
story.skycraft.q.prov_hr_orsinium.title: Orsinium Rising
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.de: Something is stirring in Red Mountain again. The Temple of the Tribunal wants the Great Houses' cooperation and someone to go into the heart of the mountain.
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.o0: Help costs. But a quiet mountain is good for trade. Hlaalu will open the roads. Tell the Temple we expect a discount on blessings.
Win House Hlaalu's support in Balmora
The Temple asks for Hlaalu's help on Red Mountain.
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.o1: Redoran has been on Red Mountain for a thousand years. Go through the Ghostfence; our wardens will hold the gate behind you.
Win House Redoran's support in Ald'ruhn
The Temple needs Redoran on Red Mountain.
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.o3: Fight through the ash creatures of Red Mountain
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.o5: Quiet for now. The Temple will keep this shard where no Sleeper can find it. You have the gratitude of the Tribunal, and of all three Houses, which is rarer.
Bring the shard to Tharen Veloth in Vivec
story.skycraft.q.prov_mw_red_mountain.pi: Red Mountain. Ash storms, and in the storms, voices. Sleepers walk out of the ash in Balmora and Ald'ruhn. The Great Houses argue; the Temple must act. Speak with Hlaalu and Redoran, and then go to the mountain.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.desc: A magister of Alinor says that recovering a stolen shard of the Crystal Tower might earn the attention of the Psijic Order, whose island of Artaeum appears only to those it chooses.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.o3.text: Sail to Artaeum, which is suddenly on the horizon
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.o4.repl: And so Artaeum let you land. Stay a while. The Order teaches nothing quickly.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.o4.text: Give the shard to Celinar of the Psijic Order
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.o4.topi: I've brought the Crystal Tower's shard.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.offer: I've heard Artaeum can't be found.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.pitch: It can't. Unless the Psijic Order wants you. Maormer raiders stole a shard of the Crystal Tower; return it, and perhaps the Order will notice you. Perhaps.
story.skycraft.q.prov_sum_psijic.title: Isle of the Psijics
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.desc: Spinner Aerfin of Elden Root wants me to live by the Green Pact, the Bosmer covenant with their forest, and bring a graht-oak seed out of the thorn-choked Green Heart.
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.o0.t: Hunt three beasts, as the Pact allows
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.o4.r: Then the Pact is in you, whatever your ears look like. We'll plant it in Falinesti's old ground. One day it'll walk.
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.o4.t: Bring the seed to Spinner Aerfin
The Wilderking gave me the seed.
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.offe: Tell me about the Green Pact.
story.skycraft.q.prov_vw_green_pact.pitc: Better: live it. Hunt as we hunt; take only flesh. Then go to the Green Heart, where thorns choke the old trees. The Wilderking guards a seed there. If the Pact is in you, he'll give it.
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.desc: Raven Rock is attacked by ash spawn, creatures of ash that walk out of the wastes.
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.o0.text: Destroy the ash spawn at Raven Rock's wall
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.o1.reply: For now is more than we usually get. The Council sends its thanks. And so does my bar tab.
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.o1.topic: The ash spawn are gone, for now.
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.pitch: Ash spawn. They crawl out of the ash itself and walk on the wall. The Redoran Guard can't hold them every night. Help them, and the Council will pay.
story.skycraft.q.sol_ash_spawn.title: March of the Dead
story.skycraft.q.sol_cleansing_the_stone: The Skaal shaman Storn says Miraak is using the All-Maker's stones to bend Solstheim to his will. Each must be cleansed with my Voice.
The All-Maker's stones: Wind, Sun, Water, Beast, Tree. Miraak has poisoned them all. Your Voice cleansed the Earth Stone; cleanse the others, and he loses his grip on my people.
Speak with Storn in the Skaal village
I feel it. The wind is ours again. But Miraak drew his power from a Black Book. To face him you'll need one too. Neloth, the Telvanni wizard, collects such things.
story.skycraft.q.sol_dragonborn.desc: Masked cultists attacked me on the road, calling me a false Dragonborn. Their orders mention a place called Solstheim and a man named Miraak.
story.skycraft.q.sol_dragonborn.o2.reply: Miraak? No. But half the town wakes up every morning with blisters on their hands and no memory of the night. They walk out to the old stone by the shore and build something. You might look at that.
story.skycraft.q.sol_dragonborn.o2.text: Ask about Miraak in Raven Rock
story.skycraft.q.sol_dragonborn.o2.topic: Have you heard of someone called Miraak?
story.skycraft.q.sol_dragonborn.title: Dragonborn
story.skycraft.q.sol_path_of_knowledge.d: Neloth knows of a Black Book in Nchardak, a Dwemer ruin in the east of Solstheim. Reading it may show me how Miraak learned his power.
story.skycraft.q.sol_path_of_knowledge.o: Naturally. There is one in Nchardak, behind a great many Dwemer puzzles and a great many Dwemer machines. Fetch it. Don't read it on my floor.
Speak with Neloth at Tel Mithryn
Take the Black Book from Nchardak
Inside the Black Book, Hermaeus Mora granted me a word of a Shout that bends the will of others. Miraak learned it here, long ago.
story.skycraft.q.sol_summit_of_apocrypha: Storn read the Black Book Waking Dreams, and gave his life to show me the way to Miraak. It is time to face the first Dragonborn.
Read Waking Dreams at the Temple of Miraak
story.skycraft.q.sol_temple_of_miraak.de: The people of Raven Rock sleepwalk to an old standing stone and build a shrine around it. The Earth Stone. My Voice might break whatever holds them.
story.skycraft.q.sol_temple_of_miraak.o1: Free the Earth Stone with Unrelenting Force
story.skycraft.q.sol_temple_of_miraak.o2: Travel to the Temple of Miraak
story.skycraft.q.sol_temple_of_miraak.o3: Fight through the Temple of Miraak
story.skycraft.q.sol_temple_of_miraak.o5: Miraak. The first Dragonborn. He's been gone for millennia and he's not gone at all. Come to my village. Our shaman will know what to do.
story.skycraft.q.tg_blindsighted.desc: Mercer Frey is after the Eyes of the Falmer, the great gems of the Dwemer ruin Irkngthand. That's where we'll catch him.
story.skycraft.q.tg_blindsighted.o1.text: Fight through the Falmer of Irkngthand
story.skycraft.q.tg_blindsighted.o3.repl: Then there's one thing left. The Key goes home to the Twilight Sepulcher. Keep the gems; the Guild needs them more than Nocturnal does.
story.skycraft.q.tg_blindsighted.o3.topi: Mercer is dead. I have the Key.
story.skycraft.q.tg_blindsighted.title: Blindsighted
story.skycraft.q.tg_chance_arrangement.d: Brynjolf, a fast talker in Riften's market, offered me work for coin: steal something unnoticed, then meet him in the Ragged Flagon under the city.
story.skycraft.q.tg_chance_arrangement.o: Steal something in Riften without being caught
Find the Ragged Flagon in the Ratway
Clean work. Welcome to the Thieves Guild, then. Mercer Frey runs things here, but you'll deal with me. First, we have a few debts to collect.
What kind of work are you offering?
story.skycraft.q.tg_chance_arrangement.p: Something a bit shady. Lift a ring from a market stall and plant it on a merchant. Do it clean, and there's more where that came from. Meet me in the Ragged Flagon after.
story.skycraft.q.tg_dampened_spirits.des: Honningbrew Meadery is cutting into the Black-Briar mead trade, and whoever bought Goldenglow is behind it. Maven wants Honningbrew ruined at its own tasting.
Problem? An infestation! Clear out the basement and I'll pay you. Here, put this bane on the nests. Careful, it's strong.
Talk to Sabjorn at Honningbrew Meadery
I hear you have a skeever problem.
Clear the skeevers from the meadery cellar
Captain of the guard tastes it at the opening, Sabjorn hangs, Honningbrew is mine. You have a future, thief.
Sabjorn's 'pest poison' is something else entirely.
story.skycraft.q.tg_darkness_returns.des: The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Ebonmere in the Twilight Sepulcher, Nocturnal's temple. Only then will the Guild's luck return.
Return the Skeleton Key to the Ebonmere
I can feel it already: the coin's flowing again. The Guild needs a Guild Master, and nobody's earned it like you.
Return to Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon
It's done. The Key is home.
story.skycraft.q.tg_loud_and_clear.desc: The owner of Goldenglow Estate, the honey farm on the lake, has stopped paying the Guild. Maven Black-Briar, our best client, wants the estate hurt badly, and wants to know who's backing its owner.
story.skycraft.q.tg_loud_and_clear.o2.jo: Inside the safe was a bill of sale. Someone else bought Goldenglow, and signed it with a mark: a stylized sun.
story.skycraft.q.tg_loud_and_clear.o3.re: A buyer with a sun for a signature... Honningbrew Meadery has the same mark on its barrels. That's next. Maven will be pleased.
story.skycraft.q.tg_loud_and_clear.o3.te: Bring the bill of sale to Brynjolf
story.skycraft.q.tg_loud_and_clear.title: Loud and Clear
story.skycraft.q.tg_scoundrels_folly.des: The sun mark belongs to a rival, and the trail leads to Snow Veil Sanctum, where a Guild traitor named Karliah may be hiding. Mercer Frey wants her dead.
Karliah. She murdered our last Guild Master, Gallus, twenty-five years ago. Now she's back. She's hiding in Snow Veil Sanctum. You're coming with me.
Brynjolf says you have a job for me.
Meet Mercer at Snow Veil Sanctum
Mercer said that? Mercer shot you in the back a moment ago. Look at the wound. Then listen to me.
Mercer... the vault! He's emptied the vault! Go with Karliah. I'll hold the Guild together. Find him.
Mercer's been robbing the Guild blind. Gallus wrote it down.
story.skycraft.q.tg_taking_care_of_busin: Brynjolf wants three of Riften's merchants reminded that they owe the Guild: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga.
Tell Brynjolf he will have it. And tell him to stop sending strangers to my bar.
Not the urn! Fine, fine. Here. Take it and get out.
You owe the Guild. Pay up, or the pottery pays.
Dibella forgive me, I meant to pay. Here. And not a word about the... visitors to my bunkhouse.
Brynjolf sent me about your debt.
That's the way. Next job is bigger: Maven Black-Briar wants the Goldenglow Estate taught a lesson.
