story.skycraft.q.tg_trinity_restored.des: Karliah was a Nightingale, one of three agents sworn to the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. To catch Mercer we need Nocturnal's favor, and the Nightingale armor waiting in Nightingale Hall.
Then stand on the circle. Don't speak until she does.
Take the Nightingale oath with Karliah
story.skycraft.scene.abduction.0: You fall asleep. You wake on the floor of a shack you've never seen, wrists free, door barred. Three hooded figures kneel, bound, along the wall.
story.skycraft.scene.abduction.1: Sleep well? You killed Grelod. A contract that was ours to take. Now you owe us a life. One of these three. Your choice.
story.skycraft.scene.alduin_dies.0: Zu'u unslaad! Zu'u nis oblaan... I am eternal... I cannot end...
story.skycraft.scene.alduin_dies.1: The World-Eater breaks apart into light, and his soul scatters across Sovngarde like sparks on the wind. Even the honored dead fall silent.
story.skycraft.scene.alduin_flees.0: Krosis... this is not over, joor. I will feast on the dead of Sovngarde and return stronger than ever.
story.skycraft.scene.alduin_flees.1: Alduin hurls himself into the clouds and is gone.
story.skycraft.scene.alduins_wall.0: There, in the center: Alduin himself, cast down. Not slain! Cast out, by the ancient tongues with a Shout of their own making.
story.skycraft.scene.alduins_wall.1: They called it Dragonrend. A Shout that forces a dragon to understand mortality. It is the only weapon the wall shows.
story.skycraft.scene.alduins_wall.2: Then the Greybeards must know it. They know everything about the Voice.
story.skycraft.scene.apocrypha.0: The Black Book opens in your hands and the world folds. Green sky. Black water. Towers of books, and tentacles where a horizon should be.
story.skycraft.scene.apocrypha.1: Another Dragonborn in my realm. How interesting. Miraak was my champion. Perhaps he still is. Prove otherwise.
story.skycraft.scene.artaeum.0: Artaeum appears to those the Order has need of. Sit. Breathe. Listen to the old ways. When you leave, you will see magic differently.
story.skycraft.scene.azura.0: Child of the twilight. A sorcerer has stolen my Star and twisted it into a prison for his own soul. Find him in the drowned fort of Ilinalta's Deep, and cleanse it.
story.skycraft.scene.barbas.0: Hey, friend. Yes, the dog is talking. Name's Barbas. My master, Clavicus Vile, and I had a little disagreement. Help me get back to him?
story.skycraft.scene.barbas.1: The dog trots ahead toward Haemar's Shame, tail wagging, as if it knows exactly where you're going.
story.skycraft.scene.boethiah.0: My champion grows soft. Kill him, take his place, and I will dress you in my mail. Betrayal is the only true virtue.
story.skycraft.scene.burning.0: Down on the Solitude square, an effigy of King Olaf burns, and the whole city sings your restored verse.
story.skycraft.scene.burning.1: Listen to them! Two hundred years since anyone sang it right. You've saved the festival, and maybe the College.
story.skycraft.scene.call_odahviing.0: You call the name into the open sky above Whiterun. For a long moment, nothing.
story.skycraft.scene.clavicus.0: You brought back my dog. Wonderful. Now kill him with the axe, and I'll give you the Masque. Or give me back the axe and keep your sentimental attachments.
story.skycraft.scene.clavicus.1: Don't listen to him. I'm a good dog.
story.skycraft.scene.council.0: Jarl Ulfric. General Tullius. You are here because the Dragonborn asked it. Sit. Speak. Shout if you must, but not here.
story.skycraft.scene.council.1: The talk goes long into the night. In the end the generals sign: a truce until the dragon is dealt with.
story.skycraft.scene.cultists.0: You are no Dragonborn! The true Dragonborn is coming. Miraak will take what you stole.
story.skycraft.scene.dagon.0: The Razor is mine. Its pieces are scattered by thieves and scholars. Reforge it at my shrine, and offer me the fool who brought you there.
The dragon's flesh burns away like paper. A storm of light pours out of the bones and into you.
By the Nine... it went into you. You're Dragonborn! The old stories said the Dragonborn could steal a dragon's power.
My grandmother told me about the Dragonborn. I never thought I'd see one.
story.skycraft.scene.dragonslayer.0: When you step back into Skyrim, every dragon in the land seems to be gathered on the Throat of the World, circling.
story.skycraft.scene.dragonslayer.1: The World-Eater is gone. Dovahkiin, you have done what none of us could. The dov will remember this.
story.skycraft.scene.dragonslayer.2: Dovahkiin. When you call, I will come. Alduin was never your equal.
story.skycraft.scene.duel.0: A shehai is the soul made into a blade. Draw yours, if you have one. Mine has been waiting a long time.
story.skycraft.scene.earth_stone.0: Your Voice slams into the stone. The black shell around it shatters, and the townsfolk who were building it blink, as if waking.
story.skycraft.scene.earth_stone.1: The stone is cleansed. Somewhere far off, someone screams in frustration.
story.skycraft.scene.emperor.0: So. The Dark Brotherhood. I knew someone would come. Do me one favor: find the man who paid for this, and do to him what you are about to do to me.
story.skycraft.scene.emperor.1: The Emperor of Tamriel does not reach for a weapon.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_anomaly.0: A shock wave rolls out of the Hall of the Elements. The Eye of Magnus burns bright, and Ancano stands before it, laughing.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_anomaly.1: None of you understand what this is. I do. Stay back, or be unmade.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_anomaly.2: Wild magic spills into the courtyard and takes shape: anomalies, crackling and hungry.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_found.0: Look at it. A great orb of pure magic, sleeping under a Nord tomb. We must take it to the College, carefully. Very carefully.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_sealed.0: It is done. The Eye is too dangerous for this world, and the Order will keep it where no one can reach it. You have done well, Arch-Mage.
story.skycraft.scene.eye_sealed.1: Arch-Mage! Ha! I always said you had a head for the Arcane.
story.skycraft.scene.falion_ritual.0: At the summoning circle the marsh mist turns gold with the first light. Falion raises the black soul gem, and it drinks.
story.skycraft.scene.falion_ritual.1: Hold still. The thing in your blood is leaving, and it does not go quietly.
story.skycraft.scene.falion_ritual.2: Cold rushes through you, then warmth: the sun on your face, and nothing in it but light.
story.skycraft.scene.green_heart.0: Who walks in my wood without the Pact? Ah. You come with the Spinner's word. Take the seed, then, and plant it where the forest bled.
story.skycraft.scene.greybeards_ro.0: You have the Voice, untrained but strong. Hear now the second word of Force: RO, Balance. Let it steady the first.
story.skycraft.scene.greybeards_ro.1: And one more, for the trial of the gate: WULD, Whirlwind. Run where no feet could carry you.
The word rolls down from the Throat of the World like thunder. Every soul in Whiterun hears it.
story.skycraft.scene.harbinger.0: There. Sovngarde, at last. You lead the Circle now, Harbinger. Lead it well.
story.skycraft.scene.harbinger.1: Kodlak's spirit fades into the cold light of the tomb. The Companions bow their heads.
story.skycraft.scene.harkon_falls.0: No... the prophecy was mine... the sun would be mine...
story.skycraft.scene.harkon_falls.1: It's over. He was my father, and I'm glad it's over. Let's go home. Wherever that is now.
story.skycraft.scene.harkon_gift.0: You returned my daughter. I am in your debt, and I pay my debts. I offer you my blood, the gift of the Vampire Lord.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_cart.0: A cart rattles over frozen ruts. Your wrists are bound; the man beside you wears the blue of a rebel.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_cart.1: Awake at last. You walked into an Imperial ambush meant for us. Bad luck, friend.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_cart.2: Prisoners off the cart! Step up to the block when your name is called.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_cart.4: Before the axe can fall, a roar splits the sky. Something vast and black lands on the watchtower.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_cart.5: Dragon! Everyone, to the keep! You, prisoner, with me or with him, but MOVE!
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_escape.0: Daylight. Behind you, smoke climbs from what was Helgen. Far off, the black dragon wheels north over the mountains.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_escape.1: Riverwood is just down the road. My sister Gerdur will help us, if you sided with me back there.
story.skycraft.scene.helgen_escape.2: My uncle Alvor is the smith in Riverwood. He'll put us up. And someone has to warn Whiterun.
story.skycraft.scene.hermaeus.0: Knowledge is the only treasure that grows when shared, and the only treasure I keep for myself. Read, mortal. Read, and become more than you were.
story.skycraft.scene.hircine.0: Sinding stole my ring and cursed himself with it. A fine hunt: the hunted beast who wears my favor. Find him in Bloated Man's Grotto, and choose your prey.
story.skycraft.scene.hist.0: We remember the root before the root. We remember you, warm-blood, though you have never come here before.
story.skycraft.scene.hist.1: The Hist speaks to you? Then you are touched. The blight is lifting.
story.skycraft.scene.karliah_truth.0: I didn't murder Gallus. Mercer Frey did, and he stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher. The Guild's bad luck is Nocturnal's displeasure.
story.skycraft.scene.karliah_truth.1: Gallus kept a journal. It's in an old script I can't read. If we can read it, the Guild will believe us.
story.skycraft.scene.kodlak_spirit.0: My Shield-Siblings. You have freed me from the hunt. The Wolf Spirit still holds the others; you know what must be done.
story.skycraft.scene.kodlak_spirit.1: Fight it here, in Ysgramor's hall, and I will pass to Sovngarde with my head held high.
story.skycraft.scene.kvatch_gate.0: The gate stands in the hills above Kvatch: twin spikes of black stone around a membrane of fire. It hums. It breathes.
story.skycraft.scene.kvatch_gate.1: Mortal! The Prince's gate opens again. Step through, and burn with the rest.
story.skycraft.scene.labyrinthian.0: Sahrot qostiid! Who wakes Morokei in his own halls? Your magicka will feed my staff.
story.skycraft.scene.malacath.0: Largashbur forgot me. Their chief grew fat and lazy. Bring me the troll's fat, kill the giant who mocks them, and I will remember Largashbur again.
story.skycraft.scene.malyn.0: You've come for the Star? I am the Star now. Come in, if you like being destroyed.
story.skycraft.scene.mephala.0: Little ears, little whispers. The Jarl's son hears me, and so do you. My blade sleeps in this palace. Wake it with a lie.
story.skycraft.scene.meridia.0: My temple is defiled by a necromancer who raises my honored dead as puppets. Purge Kilkreath, and Dawnbreaker will be yours.
story.skycraft.scene.miraak_appears.0: You've come far, but not far enough. Every soul you take, I will take from you. Solstheim is mine already. Soon, so is Skyrim.
story.skycraft.scene.miraak_appears.1: A masked figure in robes of tentacle and scale lifts his hand, and the dragon you just slew goes still. Its soul streams into him instead of you.
story.skycraft.scene.miraak_falls.0: Miraak, you thought you could hide your plans from me? You were mine from the moment you opened my book. And now, so is your successor.
story.skycraft.scene.miraak_falls.1: Tentacles pierce Miraak through. His power, and the souls he stole, pour out of him and into you.
story.skycraft.scene.molag.0: The priest came to cleanse my house. How charming. Bring him to me, and I'll give you something heavy.
story.skycraft.scene.moons.0: Both moons rise over the Temple of the Two Moons, and the silver lattice on the altar catches their light and throws it across the stones.
story.skycraft.scene.moons.1: Jone and Jode dance again. The Lunar Lattice holds. The Mane will want to hear this.
story.skycraft.scene.namira.0: Eola keeps my old feast. Join it. Taste what others fear, and you will never hunger as they do.
story.skycraft.scene.night_mother.0: My child. You have been chosen. Go to the Emperor's man in Volunruud, and listen.
story.skycraft.scene.night_mother.1: She spoke! She spoke to you! Oh, the Listener, the Listener has come!
story.skycraft.scene.nightingale_oath.0: In the hall of the Nightingales, Karliah leads you before a great stone circle. The shadows deepen until they feel like a held breath.
story.skycraft.scene.nightingale_oath.1: So. Another stands before me. Serve me as Nightingale, in life and after, and I will grant you my shadow. Return what was stolen.
story.skycraft.scene.nightingale_oath.2: That was Nocturnal. Now we hunt Mercer.
story.skycraft.scene.nocturnal_return.0: The Skeleton Key slides into the Ebonmere. The pool of darkness ripples, and a figure of shadow and feathers rises from it.
story.skycraft.scene.nocturnal_return.1: The Key is home. You have done what you swore. The Guild's luck is restored, and you are mine, Nightingale. Walk in shadow.
story.skycraft.scene.nocturnal_return.2: Karliah. I'm free. Thank you, friend.
story.skycraft.scene.oblivion_return.0: You tear the Sigil Stone from its socket. The tower screams, the sky of Oblivion folds in on itself, and you fall back into Cyrodiil's clean air.
story.skycraft.scene.odahviing_deal.0: Hah! The great yoke. You are clever, for a joor. Alduin's eyrie is Skuldafn, far east, beyond the reach of your feet.
story.skycraft.scene.odahviing_deal.1: Free me and I will carry you there. Alduin has shown himself weak. Perhaps it is time the dov chose a stronger master.
story.skycraft.scene.odahviing_flight.0: Hold fast. I will not fly gently. Skuldafn waits in the mountains where the snow never melts.
story.skycraft.scene.odahviing_flight.1: The ground falls away. Skyrim spreads beneath you like a map, white and green and grey, and then the eastern peaks rush up.
story.skycraft.scene.odahviing_name.0: The name you need is Odahviing: Snow, Hunter, Wing. He is Alduin's lieutenant, and proud. Call him, and he will come.
story.skycraft.scene.olaf_rises.0: Free me, and I'll sing the truth of Olaf One-Eye one last time. He stole my verse and buried me in the dark for it.
story.skycraft.scene.olaf_rises.1: You'll not have it! I am King! I am the hero of the songs!
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_after.0: He fled to Sovngarde, to feed on the souls of the honored dead. Only the dovah know the way there.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_after.1: Trap one of his own. Make it carry you. A dragon called with its own name cannot refuse to come.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_meet.0: Wings beat out of the cloud. An ancient grey dragon lands on the word wall at the summit and lowers its head.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_meet.1: Drem yol lok. Greetings, wunduniik, traveler. Before we speak, let us speak in the old way. Show me your Thu'um.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_meet.2: Here is a word for you: YOL. Fire. Speak it to me.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_slain.0: So be it. Perhaps it was always meant to end this way. Remember what I taught you, Dovahkiin.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_yol.0: Yes. You have the gift of our kind. Now hear me. Dragonrend cannot be taught: it was born of the hatred of mortals.
story.skycraft.scene.paarthurnax_yol.1: Long ago an Elder Scroll was used here, at this place, and time was wounded. Bring a Scroll back to the wound and you will see the heroes who first spoke it.
story.skycraft.scene.peryite.0: The Taskmaster has a task. My afflicted wander from Bthardamz, led by a fallen elf named Orchendor. Order requires that he be ended.
story.skycraft.scene.red_mountain.0: The heart beats still, outlander. The Tribunal is gone; the House of Troubles stirs. Sleep, and wake as one of us.
story.skycraft.scene.red_mountain.1: Ash rises from every vent of the mountain. Shapes stand up out of it.
story.skycraft.scene.saarthal_vision.0: When you lift the amulet, the chamber goes silent and a robed figure stands where there was no one a moment ago.
story.skycraft.scene.saarthal_vision.1: Listen well. What lies within Saarthal is dangerous beyond your understanding. The Psijic Order will be watching. Act wisely.
story.skycraft.scene.saarthal_vision.2: Then he is simply gone, and a sealed wall cracks open behind you.
story.skycraft.scene.sahloknir_rises.0: A black shape blots out the sun and settles on the burial mound. It speaks to the earth in its own tongue.
story.skycraft.scene.sahloknir_rises.2: The mound breaks apart. Bones knit and scales grow over them. A second dragon rises, and the black one turns to you.
story.skycraft.scene.sahloknir_rises.3: You do not even know what you are, little mortal. Sahloknir, kill it.
story.skycraft.scene.sanctuary_burns.0: Smoke rises from the Sanctuary's door. The Penitus Oculatus found it. The Black Door hangs broken.
story.skycraft.scene.sanctuary_burns.1: They came at dawn. Astrid sold us to them, and then they killed her too. We go to the old Sanctuary in Dawnstar. We finish this.
story.skycraft.scene.sanguine.0: You remember a drinking contest. You remember a lot of mead. Then you remember nothing at all, until you wake in a temple with a headache like a dragon's footstep.
story.skycraft.scene.sanguine.1: Ha! There you are. You were magnificent. Here, a souvenir of the best night anyone's had in a century.
story.skycraft.scene.serana_wakes.0: The stone sarcophagus in the heart of the crypt slides open. A pale woman steps out, blinking, an Elder Scroll strapped to her back.
story.skycraft.scene.serana_wakes.1: Who are you? How long was I in there? Never mind. I need to get home. Castle Volkihar, in the north sea. Will you take me?
story.skycraft.scene.sheogorath.0: Ah, a visitor! In the mind of Pelagius, of all places. He was so very interesting, before the strangling. Fix his little troubles and I'll go home. And you'll get a present!
story.skycraft.scene.sheogorath.1: Leave me alone! Not you too! The Night Terrors, the Confidence, the Anger! They're all in here with me!
story.skycraft.scene.skjor_dead.0: Skjor went after the Silver Hand alone while we slept. They left him in the road like a hide on a rack.
story.skycraft.scene.skjor_dead.1: Gallows Rock. That's where they keep their trophies. We take it apart, all of it.
story.skycraft.scene.solitude_falls.0: Castle Dour's gate falls in. General Tullius stands alone in his war room, sword drawn, his officers dead around him.
story.skycraft.scene.solitude_falls.1: It's done. Skyrim is ours. Sovngarde will sing of this day.
story.skycraft.scene.soul_cairn.0: A portal of red light opens in the courtyard. Beyond it, purple skies and drifting souls: the Soul Cairn, a realm of Oblivion.
story.skycraft.scene.soul_cairn.1: Serana? You came. Then Harkon is still chasing that prophecy. I hid the other Scroll here so he could never have it. Take it, and stop him.
story.skycraft.scene.sovngarde_heroes.0: I am Tsun, shield-thane of Shor. None enter the Hall of Valor without facing me, but you, you have come for other business.
story.skycraft.scene.sovngarde_heroes.1: We have waited a long age to finish what we began on the mountain. Lead us, Dragonborn.
story.skycraft.scene.sovngarde_heroes.2: The mist thins. Alduin circles the Hall, devouring the lost. Clear the sky with your Voice and bring him down.
story.skycraft.scene.sovngarde_portal.0: The staff slots into the pedestal. A column of light swallows the sky, and the stones of Skuldafn fall away beneath you.
story.skycraft.scene.stone_cleansed.0: Another stone of the All-Maker is clean. The wind on Solstheim smells a little more like the sea and a little less like ink.
story.skycraft.scene.summit.0: Hermaeus Mora gave me knowledge, and then chains. I will have neither. You came to my summit: then die here, little rival.
story.skycraft.scene.time_wound.0: The Scroll unrolls itself. The world goes grey; the snow freezes in the air. You stand among three warriors of an age long past, watching Alduin fall from the sky.
story.skycraft.scene.time_wound.1: Dragonrend has struck him! Now, while he is grounded!
story.skycraft.scene.time_wound.3: It isn't enough. He won't die. Felldir, the Scroll! Use it now!
story.skycraft.scene.time_wound.4: The vision tears apart. The three words of Dragonrend ring in your skull: JOOR, ZAH, FRUL. And above the summit, a black dragon descends.
story.skycraft.scene.time_wound.5: Dovahkiin. You are too late. Your Shout is a toy in my claws.
story.skycraft.scene.underforge.0: Beneath the Skyforge, in a hollow of rock, Skjor waits by a stone basin. Behind him stands a great wolf with Aela's eyes.
story.skycraft.scene.underforge.1: The Circle carries a gift. Some call it a curse. Drink, and you become one of us in blood as well as name.
story.skycraft.scene.underforge.2: The blood burns. For a moment the world smells of rain and fear, and you hear every heartbeat in Whiterun.
story.skycraft.scene.underforge.3: You will hunt now, and you will never be cold again.
story.skycraft.scene.vaermina.0: You walk in my dream, little thing. Erandur betrayed me once. Will you betray him, and take my Skull?
story.skycraft.scene.vale.0: Through Darkfall Cave the snow gives way to a hidden valley of waterfalls and pale trees, lit by a sun that never seems to set.
story.skycraft.scene.vale.1: You've come for the bow. Many came. The Snow Elves made sure none returned.
story.skycraft.scene.voyage.0: The Northern Maiden noses out of Windhelm's harbor and turns north and east, into the Sea of Ghosts. Two days later, ash falls on the deck.
story.skycraft.scene.voyage.1: Raven Rock: a Dunmer town under a sky the color of an old bruise. Red Mountain smokes on the horizon.
story.skycraft.scene.whiterun_falls_legi: The rebels are breaking! Hold the gate! Whiterun stands with the Empire!
So be it. Whiterun has chosen. Gods help us all.
story.skycraft.scene.whiterun_falls_stor: The gate's down! For Skyrim! Whiterun is free!
Enough. Whiterun yields. Tell Ulfric he has his city.
story.skycraft.scene.windhelm_falls.0: The Palace of the Kings is quiet. Ulfric Stormcloak kneels in his own throne room and does not ask for mercy.
story.skycraft.scene.windhelm_falls.1: It's over. Skyrim stays in the Empire. Make sure the soldiers know who won this for them.
story.skycraft.scene.wrothgar.0: The mountain does not care who your parents were. Climb it, and kill what lives at the top. Then you are Orsimer enough for me.
